name: Grappler
description:
You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling. You gain the following benefits:
- When you succeed a melee attack roll against a creature, you may attempt to grapple them as a Minor Action.
- Creatures have disadvantage on checks made to escape your grapple.
- Dragging a grappled creature does not cost double movement.
